name: Does Maine Results, Inc. offer painting services for new baseboards?

mainEntity.name: Does Maine Results, Inc. offer painting services for new baseboards?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Maine Results, Inc. offers comprehensive finishing services, including painting or staining for your newly installed baseboards. We understand that a high-quality paint or stain job is crucial for the overall aesthetic and protection of your trim. This can be included as part of your baseboard replacement project, ensuring a complete and polished look without the need to hire a separate contractor. Discuss your preferred color or stain during the initial consultation, and we will integrate it into the project plan for a seamless finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, Maine Results, Inc. offers painting and staining services for new baseboards as part of the replacement project for a complete finish.
